messages.subject: IOS web app UIWebView
parts: I want to write a IOS web app which will interact with my shiny app.  So I made a simple UIWebView app, and it works ok.  But  I want to control the shiny app with IOS.  Has anyone done work with this?  I was going to investigate socketRocket: http://corner.squareup.com/2012/02/socketrocket-websockets.html.  Any help?
